Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Plant Club boxes ship in the **first full week of each month**.

Here's how the timing works:
- You're charged on the **25th of the previous month**. For example, the box that ships in the first full week of November is billed on October 25th.
- If you skip, pause, change your plan, or cancel **before the 25th**, it affects your next box. If you do it **on or after the 25th**, the change applies to the following month's box.
- You can make these changes anytime under "Account" > "Subscriptions".

Please note that a box that has already been billed isn't refunded if you cancel, and it will still be sent.

Is there anything else I can help you with? We're always happy to chat, so please reach out any time! 🌱
